legend: Uniform small plasmacytoid cells are present with small atypical lymphoid cells against a basophilic background due to high serum immunoglobulin (Field stain).

Endobronchial ultrasound–guided transbronchial FNAB (EBUS-TBFNAB). Unstained immunoglobulin crystals are present in the cytoplasm of neoplastic lymphocytes and have accumulated in the cytoplasm of a histiocyte (Giemsa).
Mix of small lymphoid cells, plasmacytoid cells, and plasma cells, and occasional Dutcher bodies are noted (Giemsa).

Fragments of pink amorphous amyloid are present in the background and in the cytoplasm of a multinucleated giant cell amid plasmacytoid cells, small atypical lymphoid cells, and occasional larger lymphoid cells (Giemsa).

diagnosis: Flow cytometry immunophenotypic analysis of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
legend: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma is composed of B cells and plasma cells, and each component must be analysed separately. In this case, the B cells are positive for surface kappa, CD20, and CD45, and they are negative for CD5, CD10, and surface lambda. The plasma cells are positive for CD19, CD27, CD38, CD45, CD81, CD138, and cytoplasmic kappa, and they are negative for CD56, CD117, and cytoplasmic lambda.
